acquisition_method: inferred: A data dependent mass spectrometric method was employed
alkylation_concentration: alkylation (10 mM iodoacetamide, 20 min, in the dark)
alkylation_reagent: alkylation (10 mM iodoacetamide, 20 min, in the dark)
cleavage_agent: proteins were digested for 3 h by Lys-C (Wako) at a protein:enzyme ratio of 100:1. Samples were diluted with 10 mM ammonium bicarbonate to 2 M urea prior to overnight trypsin digestion
collision_energy: fragmented using higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) (normalized collision energy 25)
fractionation_method: Peptides (180 μg) were separated by in-solution isoelectric focusing (OFFGEL fractionator, Agilent) into 12 fractions over a pH range of 3–10.
fragmentation_method: fragmented using higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
instrument: using an EASY nLC-II coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany)
labeling: quantitative high resolution nano-LC-MS/MS based on stable isotope labeling with amino acid in cell culture (SILAC)
ptm: methionine oxidation, cysteine carbamidomethylation, N-terminal acetylation
allowing for maximum two missed cleavages, N-terminal acetylation and methionine oxidation as variable modifications and cysteine carbamidomethylation as fixed modification
